title: Bound-State Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the modification of the bound-state energy caused by the wall.

title: Far Away Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly explain the condition for the wall being 'far away' in terms of d and k.

title: Existence Condition
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the correct condition on V0 and d for the existence of at least one bound state.

title: Wave Function Continuity
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the continuity of the wave function and its derivative at x = 0.

title: Correct Use of k
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define and use the variable k in their calculations.

title: Exponential Approximation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide an approximation for k when d is large, showing understanding of limiting cases.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the equations, particularly in the energy expression.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.
